name: Tactical Warm Compress Bandaging
description: When your Ifa, who has this card equipped, is on the field and you trigger Anemo-Related Reactions, Electro-Charged, or Lunar-Charged, heal the character on your team who has taken the most DMG for 1 HP. (Twice per Round)
